empty.title: Ask your memory.
empty.body: Every answer shows, sentence by sentence, what Cogeto can prove, and honestly marks what it can't. The web is searched only when you ask and approve.

conversation.railFooter: What Cogeto learns here is remembered everywhere: conversations organise talk, memory keeps knowledge.
